name: We Were Racers: First Drive
detailed_description:
We Were Racers: First Drive is a story-driven, arcade-style street racing game set in the night streets of Echo Hills, a reimagined city inspired by a real-world location.

 

Compete in high-stakes races, build your reputation, and carve out your place in the underground scene. But as you push forward, you'll realize there's more to these streets than just racing.

Over 400km of road to drive on, From the calm of the back roads to the eerie quiet of the city streets, from the low hum of industrial zones to the warmth of residential areas, and from stunning hilltop views to the winding roads below, this city has something for everyone.

 

Whether you prefer high-speed straights or sliding through corners, tight technical turns or long, sweeping bends, the roads here will test your skills. Built across hills and valleys, this city delivers constant elevation changes and a variety of terrain, making every drive feel different.

Follow the protagonist as he races through the night, pushing forward toward a goal even he isn’t sure of. With a few trusted companions by his side, he takes on racer after racer—but in this world, trust is a dangerous thing.

 

Every race brings him closer to something—answers, the past, or maybe just another dead end. Will he find what he’s been looking for, or was he never meant to get there?

·         A Dark & Atmospheric Open World – Race through a beautifully reimagined city, where neon-lit streets, eerie back roads, residential zones and industrial districts create a unique underground racing experience.

·         High-Stakes Street Racing – Every race is a gamble, take on rivals, and push your limits. But with limited restarts, every decision counts.

·         Dramatic Road Design – A map built with elevation changes, winding turns, and fast straights, offering an ever-challenging driving experience.

·         A Story-Driven Racing Experience – Uncover a narrative woven into the world as you rise through the ranks and question who you can truly trust.

·         Ever-Changing Weather Conditions – Adapt to clear, windy, foggy, and rainy conditions, each affecting visibility and driving feel.

·         A World Built From the Ground Up – Every building, road, and environment model has been handcrafted from scratch—no city assets, just a fully original world.

·         Custom-Designed Cars – No recycled models—every car has been built from the ground up, designed specifically for this game’s racing experience.

 

More features are in the works, with future updates bringing even more depth to the experience. Stay tuned.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12GB) / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
